title: Boundary
description: The extent of a governed area over a period of time. A separate, citable entity rather than a field on the jurisdiction, because boundaries change and the change matters: wards are redrawn, municipalities annex and merge, electoral districts are reapportioned. A 2022 contest was fought on the 2022 boundary, and a budget line or permit attributed to an area is anchored to the boundary in force at the time. Attaching a single current geometry to a jurisdiction silently rewrites history.

boundaryOf.description: The Jurisdiction this is the extent of.

validUntil.description: When it ceased to apply. Absent means current. A superseded boundary is retained, not deleted - it is what historical records were drawn against.

authoritative.description: Whether this is the legally definitive extent, as opposed to a published rendering of it.
